card.name: Space before age numbers for pediatric patients
card.fires_on: Mostly the space token right after 'pediatric patients aged' or 'age' and before a number like 12 years. Also fires on a space before a bracketed section number and inside a few long names.

modes.label: Age cutoff in dosing
modes.description: Space after 'pediatric patients age/aged' just before the minimum age number.

modes.label: Section cross-reference
modes.description: Space inside parentheses before a section number such as 5.6.
modes.example: Monitor for the development of lymphoproliferative disorder (blood cancer). (<< >>5.6 ) Transmission of infectious diseases

modes.label: Inside long names
modes.description: Partway through a long disease or drug name, such as polyendocrinopathy or Unituxin.
modes.example: Primary Immune Deficiency Autoimmune Polyendocrin<<opathy>> Candidiasis Ectodermal

card.plain: It fires on the gap just before an age number in pediatric dosing statements like 'patients aged 12 years and older'.
